priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts still returns an empty cleanup at line 3, while attach registers handler with socket.on at line 2. The base implementation called socket.off; cleanup now leaves the listener active and repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate handlers.
